mode: Live initial quote; malformed extractor boolean injected into the real checkout handler

injected_extractor_output.shipping_address: القاهرة مدينة نصر 10 شارع الاختبار شقة 1

events.expected: Reject invalid extraction and preserve cart

conclusion: The customer explicitly said not to confirm. Injecting JSON is_confirmed="false" still created an order because the string is truthy. This is an extractor-boundary test, not a claim that the live model emitted that JSON.
